200.body: The present is decorated with amber details and American symbols Polish President Karol Nawrocki presented his US counterpart, Donald Trump, with “an amber throne” for his 80th birthday, according to media reports. The gift was handed over in Washington during celebrations on June 14 for Trump's birthday, an event that was also framed as marking the 250th anniversary of the signing of the American Declaration of Independence, Polish news outlet TVN24 reported on Wednesday. In June, Marcin Przydacz, head of the Polish president's Office of International Policy, said Trump would receive two gifts from Nawrocki, “one from the state,” and “a more personal” one. Gift 'made an impression' TVN24 said that the 'throne', a chair decorated with amber details and American symbols, was made by renowned Polish amber artist Lucjan Myrta.

300.title: Can the Moon make money? Polish firm to test lunar mining business
300.summary: Adobe Stock A Polish company will lead a European Space Agency (ESA)-backed study into whether extracting water, oxygen, helium-3 and other resources on the Moon could become a profitable business, and what infrastructure would be needed to make it work.
300.body: Adobe Stock A Polish company will lead a European Space Agency (ESA)-backed study into whether extracting water, oxygen, helium-3 and other resources on the Moon could become a profitable business, and what infrastructure would be needed to make it work. MIRORES will head the LUNAVEST consortium, which will assess the costs of extracting, processing, storing and transporting lunar resources, as well as the potential demand for them. The model will combine information about lunar resources with estimates of extraction and processing costs, infrastructure investment, maintenance, energy supplies, transport and potential revenue. For Polish companies, the work could provide an opportunity to contribute both to the identification of lunar resources and to planning the infrastructure and commercial activities needed to develop a future lunar economy. (PAP) akp/ bar/ tr.

600.title: Poland avoid Nations League drop with Sweden draw
600.summary: Poland have retained their place in the UEFA Nations League's second tier after drawing 1-1 with promoted Sweden in Wrocław on Tuesday, having won just one of their six matches in the campaign. Adrian Benedyczak, making his first international start in place of Robert Lewandowski, put Poland ahead in the 16th minute, with Sweden’s mid-fielder Hugo Larsson equalizing just eight minutes later.
600.body: Poland have retained their place in the UEFA Nations League's second tier after drawing 1-1 with promoted Sweden in Wrocław on Tuesday, having won just one of their six matches in the campaign. Adrian Benedyczak, making his first international start in place of Robert Lewandowski, put Poland ahead in the 16th minute, with Sweden’s mid-fielder Hugo Larsson equalizing just eight minutes later. Poland finished third in Group B4, avoiding a relegation playoff after Bosnia and Herzegovina beat Romania 2-1. The result followed Poland’s 2-1 loss to Romania on Saturday, which intensified scrutiny of coach Jan Urban.
